raw_chat.content:
I have fixed the issue where visiting `/roll/` would raise an `AttributeError` if no rolls existed in the database. The error occurred because the code attempted to access the `embargo` attribute of `last_roll` even when `last_roll` was `None`.

I modified `will_of_the_prophets/views.py` to check if `last_roll` exists. If it does, it uses its `embargo` timestamp; otherwise, it defaults to the current time (`timezone.now()`) when initializing the `Board` object.

Summary of changes:
- `will_of_the_prophets/views.py`: Updated `RollView.get_context_data` to safely handle cases where no rolls have been made yet.
